分裂基于假设的论证框架Splitting Assumption-Based Argumentation Frameworks

Giovanni Buraglio    Wolfgang Dvořák    Stefan Woltran
\affiliationsInstitute of Logic and Computation, TU Wien, Austria
\emails{giovanni.buraglio, wolfgang.dvorak, stefan.woltran}@tuwien.ac.at
摘要Abstract

基于假设的论证 (ABA) 是一种行之有效的辩论建模和推理形式，具有广泛的应用。然而，ABA 中核心推理任务的高计算复杂度对其适用性提出了重大挑战。当 ABA 框架 (ABAF) 实例化为基于图的论证形式时，例如 Dung 的论证框架 (AF) 和集体攻击论证框架 (SETAF)，这个问题会进一步加剧。在知识表示和推理中，解决计算难题的关键策略是通过分治算法优化给定知识库的推理。这种方法的一个典型示例是拆分，其中通过将搜索空间仅限于子框架来增量计算给定框架的扩展，然后组合获得的结果。这种方法已成功应用于 AF，并在稳定语义下引入了参数化版本。然而，实例化产生的指数增长可能会破坏 ABAF 引起的参数图分裂的有用性。为了解决这个问题，我们的工作研究了知识库分裂的概念，而不是基于图的实例化。此外，我们将分裂推广到 ABAF 的参数化版本。Assumption-Based Argumentation (ABA) is a well-established formalism for modelling and reasoning over debates, with a wide range of applications. However, the high computational complexity of core reasoning tasks in ABA poses a significant challenge for its applicability. This issue is further aggravated when ABA frameworks (ABAFs) are instantiated into graph-based argumentation formalisms, such as Dung’s Argumentation Frameworks (AFs) and Argumentation Frameworks with Collective Attacks (SETAFs). In knowledge representation and reasoning, a key strategy to address computational intractability is to optimise reasoning over a given knowledge base through divide-and-conquer algorithms. A paradigmatic example of this approach is splitting, where extensions of a given framework are computed incrementally, by restricting the search space to sub-frameworks only, and then combining the obtained results. This approach has been successfully applied to AFs, for which also a parametrised version has been introduced under stable semantics. However, the exponential growth produced by the instantiation might undermine the usefulness of splitting on the argument graphs induced by ABAFs. To address this issue, our work investigates the concept of splitting on the knowledge base rather than on its graph-based instantiation. Furthermore, we generalise splitting to its parametrised version for ABAFs.

1 简介Introduction

人工智能论证的计算模型（Computational models of argumentation in AI (?）提供正式的方法来表达和推理涉及冲突或不确定信息的辩论（) offer formal approaches to represent and reason over debates involving conflicting or uncertain information (?; ?; ?; ?; ?; ?）。 基于假设的论证 (ABA)（). Assumption-Based Argumentation (ABA) (?）通过所谓的 ABA 框架（ABAF）或 ABA 知识库捕获论证场景，由一组可废止的句子（假设）和推理规则组成。 论证推理可以在 ABA 中按照两种不同的方法进行。的) captures argumentative scenarios by means of so-called ABA frameworks (ABAFs), or ABA knowledge bases, consisting of a set of defeasible sentences (assumptions) and inference rules. Argumentative reasoning can be performed in ABA following two different approaches. The直接direct方法，通常由 ABA 求解器采用（approach, typically employed by ABA solvers (?; ?），允许通过假设级别定义的语义对 ABA 知识库本身进行推理。相比之下，), allows to reason over the ABA knowledge base itself through semantics defined at the level of assumptions. In contrast, the间接indirect方法（approach (?）通过两步过程实现推理：首先，通过所谓的 ABAF 生成包含参数及其关系的参数图) realises reasoning in a two-step process: first an argument graph comprising arguments and their relations is generated from the ABAF, by means of the so-called实例化instantiation程序；那么，procedure; then,语义semantics将抽象论证应用于所获得的图表，以便找到可接受的论证集以及支持它们的假设。from abstract argumentation are applied to the obtained graph in order to find acceptable sets of arguments, along with the assumptions supporting them.

尽管 ABA 是一种成熟的非单调推理形式主义，可应用于医疗决策、可解释的人工智能和因果发现（Although ABA is a well-established formalism for non-monotonic reasoning, with applications in medical decision-making, explainable AI, and causal discovery (?; ?; ?），ABA 中核心推理任务的高计算复杂度对其在实践中的部署提出了重大挑战（), the high computational complexity of core reasoning tasks in ABA poses a significant challenge for its deployment in practice (?）。当 ABAF 实例化为参数图时，例如 Dung 的论证框架 (AF)（). This issue is further aggravated when ABAFs are instantiated into argument graphs, such as Dung’s Argumentation Frameworks (AFs) (?）或集体攻击论证框架（SETAF）（) or Argumentation Frameworks with Collective Attacks (SETAFs) (?），因为实例化的计算成本可能很高，并且可能会导致指数级大的图（), as the instantiation can be computationally expensive and may result in exponentially large graphs (?).

在非单调推理的背景下，解决计算难题的一种重要策略是通过分治算法优化给定知识库的推理。这种方法的一个典型例子是In the context of non-monotonic reasoning, one prominent strategy to address computational intractability is to optimise reasoning over a given knowledge base through divide-and-conquer algorithms. A paradigmatic example of this approach is分裂splitting，最初是为答案集编程而开发的（, originally developed for answer-set programming (?），后来适应其他非单调形式，例如默认理论（) and later adapted to other nonmonotonic formalisms, e.g. default theories (?）和最近的抽象论证（) and recently Abstract Argumentation (?; ?; ?; ?; ?; ?）。 这种方法侧重于通过子框架的扩展来增量计算给定论证框架的扩展，从而避免考虑原始框架的整个解决方案空间。). This approach focuses on incrementally computing the extensions of a given argumentation framework by means of the extension of its sub-frameworks, thereby avoiding to consider the entire solution-space of the original framework.

尽管在基于图的论证中取得了成功的应用（Despite the successful application in graph-based argumentation (?），到目前为止，对于基于规则的论证系统（例如基于假设的论证），分裂一直被忽略。 在 ABA 中应用分割的一个直接尝试是首先将 ABAF 实例化为相应的 Dung AF，然后执行 AF 分割。然而，在实例化过程中引入的指数数量的辅助参数可能会使分割的用处失效。 为了克服这个限制，我们考虑将 ABAF 实例化为 SETAF，这会产生更简洁的图形表示（), splitting, so far, has been neglected for rule-based argumentation systems like Assumption-Based Argumentation. A straightforward attempt to apply splitting in ABA would be to first instantiate the ABAF to a corresponding Dung’s AF and then perform AF splitting. However, the exponential number of auxiliary arguments introduced during instantiation might invalidate the usefulness of splitting. To overcome this limitation, we instead consider the instantiation of ABAFs as SETAFs, which yield more concise graphical representations (?）。 因此，我们首先开发了 SETAF 的分割方案，为间接推理方法提供增量计算。 该方法的优点是可以轻松应用于任何可以实例化为 SETAF 的形式。然而，它的缺点是我们必须实例化知识库，这会带来计算成本，而且我们甚至无法使用分裂来加速实例化步骤。 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种直接在 ABA 知识库上运行的拆分模式。 为此，本文做出以下贡献：). Thus, we first develop a splitting scheme for SETAFs, enabling incremental computation for the indirect approach of reasoning. This method has the advantage of being easily applicable to any formalism that can be instantiated as a SETAF. However, its drawback is that we have to instantiate the knowledge base, which comes with a computational cost, and we cannot even use the splitting to speed up the instantiation step. To address this issue, we present a splitting schema that operates directly on ABA knowledge bases. To this end, this paper makes the following contributions:

  • •

    对于 ABA 分裂，我们将现有的从 AF 分裂的概念推广到 SETAF（第 1 节）Towards ABA splitting, we generalise existing notions of splitting from AFs to SETAFs (Section3) 以获得完整、稳定、首选和基础的语义。) for complete, stable, preferred and grounded semantics.

  • •

    然后我们在第 1 节中介绍 ABA 分裂的概念We then introduce the notion of ABA splitting in Section4，以及建立分裂定理所需的句法调整，我们在完整、稳定、首选和扎根的语义下证明了这一点。, along with the syntactic adjustments required to establish a splitting theorem, which we prove under complete, stable, preferred and grounded semantics.

  • •

    在部分In Section5我们将我们的结果扩展到更一般的概念we extend our results to the more general notion of参数化分裂parameterised splitting (?），表明在稳定语义下，ABAF 的分裂定理成立。), showing that a splitting theorem holds for ABAFs under stable semantics.

  • •

    在部分In Section6我们通过将其简化为图分割问题并重用 AF 的专用算法来解决 SETAF 和 ABAF 的计算分割问题。we address computing splittings for SETAFs and ABAFs, by reducing it to a graph splitting problem and reusing dedicated algorithms for AFs.

  • •

    在部分In Section7我们仔细研究了 ABAF 的分割算法和 SETAF 的实例化过程之间的关系。we take a closer look at the relationship between the splitting algorithm for ABAFs and the instantiation procedure into SETAFs.

  • •

    最后，在回顾了相关工作之后（第Finally, after reviewing related work (Section8），我们总结并概述了未来研究的方向（第), we conclude with a summary and outline directions for future research (Section9).

Due to their popularity and simple structure, this step has traditionally been performed by means of Dung’s AFs (?; ?; ?），即有向图，其中节点及其（二元）关系被解释为它们之间的参数和攻击。 然而，这种表示并没有捕捉到多个假设直接攻击另一个假设的可能性，这可能会导致大量的辅助参数。因此，近年来，超图表示（), i.e., directed graphs where nodes and their (binary) relation are interpreted as arguments and attacks among them. 虽然从 ABA 框架到 SETAF 的现有实例化过程为定义分裂提供了基础，但尝试直接复制假设之间的分裂的 SETAF 式思想无法产生自然的分裂概念。 这种脱节源于根本的结构差异：在 SETAF 中，攻击是原始的，而在 ABA 中，它们源自底层演绎系统While the existing instantiation procedure from ABA frameworks to SETAFs provides a foundation for defining splitting, attempting to directly replicate the SETAF-style idea of splitting among assumptions fails to yield a natural notion of splitting. This disconnect stems from a fundamental structural difference: in SETAFs, attacks are primitive, whereas in ABA, they are derived from the underlying deductive system(ℒ,ℛ)(\mathcal{L},\mathcal{R})。因此，天真地模仿 ABA 中的 SETAF 式分割需要 (i) 将假设集任意划分为. As a result, naively mimicking SETAF-style splitting in ABA would require (i) arbitrarily partitioning the assumption set into𝒜1\mathcal{A}_{1}和and𝒜2\mathcal{A}_{2}，和（ii）计算攻击作为假设的推导, and (ii) computing attacks as derivations from assumptions in𝒜1\mathcal{A}_{1}给那些在to those in𝒜2\mathcal{A}_{2}。 然而，仅通过检查手头的知识库就可以进行拆分。 此外，虽然将 ABAF 实例化为 SETAF 在特定上下文中已被证明是有用的（. However, splitting should be possible solely by inspecting the knowledge base at hand. Moreover, while instantiating ABAFs into SETAFs has been shown useful in specific contexts (?; ?），这种方法有一个严重的缺点：它可以使生成的集体攻击数量呈指数增长，从而增加输入大小。这种低效率促使许多 ABA 求解器直接在 ABAF 上运行，而不是依赖它们的抽象表示。 因此，为了实现有效的分割形式，我们提出了一种针对 ABAF 句法结构的专用分割算法。), this approach comes with a critical drawback: it can yield an exponential growth in the number of collective attacks generated, thus increasing in input size. This inefficiency motivates many ABA solvers to operate directly on ABAFs rather than relying on their abstract representations. Therefore, to enable an efficient form of splitting, we propose a dedicated splitting algorithm tailored to the syntactic structure of ABAFs.

4 基于假设的论证的分裂Splitting in Assumption-Based Argumentation

在本节中，我们将介绍 ABAF 的拆分结果。 当底部部分没有发生假设而其相反情况是由顶部的某些规则导出时，ABAF 的规则集被分为底部和顶部部分。 这确保了底部的假设可以独立于通过检查顶部部分推断出的内容进行评估。我们通过分裂集的概念来捕捉这种直觉：In this section we present splitting results for ABAFs. The rule-set of an ABAF is split into a bottom and a top part whenever no assumption occurs in the bottom part whose contrary is derived by some rule in the top. This ensures that the assumptions in the bottom can be evaluated independently of what can be deduced by inspecting the top part. We capture this intuition via the notion of splitting set:

However, as anticipated in the introduction, splitting is only possible when certain structural properties are met. For graph-based frameworks, it is required that all attacks between the two sub-frameworks share the same direction. For this reason, the presence of a single attack can invalidate the possibility of splitting (e.g. when the AF in question has the form of a Strongly Connected Component (SCC)). 正如前面的示例所示，两种策略都允许相同的分割，并且， 事实上，计算出相同的预期结果。 当将分割与基于实例化的求解器相结合时，上述考虑因素为整个推理过程中如何以及何时分割提供了不同的可能性。当实例化可行时，第一个策略是生成 SETAF 并在图级别应用分割模式。 或者，当不可能时，可以首先拆分 ABAFAs the previous example showcases, both strategies allow for the same splittings and, indeed, compute the same expected result. When combining splitting with an instantiation based solver, the above considerations open different possibilities of how and when to split throughout the reasoning process. A first strategy, when instantiation is feasible, is to generate the SETAF and apply the splitting schema at the level of the graph. Alternatively, when this is not possible, one can first split the ABAFDD进入intoD1D_{1}和andD2D_{2}，然后将它们实例化为 SETAF, then instantiate them into SETAFsS​FD1SF_{D_{1}}和andS​FD2SF_{D_{2}}并应用SETAF分裂算法，即修改and apply the SETAF splitting algorithm, i.e. modifyS​FD2SF_{D_{2}}进入into(S​FD2)⋆(SF_{D_{2}})^{\star}并计算要合并的扩展。 在整个 ABAF 的参数图太难计算的情况下，这可能允许人们使用 SETAF 分裂算法。and compute extensions to be merged. This might allow one to utilise the SETAF splitting algorithm in cases where the argument graph of the entire ABAF is too hard to compute.

8 相关工作Related Work

我们特此澄清我们的分裂方法与 SCC 递归性的关系（We hereby clarify the relation of our splitting approach to SCC-recursiveness (?; ?），并且我们将我们的分裂概念与逻辑程序（LP）的现有概念进行比较（), and we compare our notion of splitting to existing ones for logic programs (LPs) (?）和抽象辩证框架（ADF）（) and abstract dialectical frameworks (ADFs) (?), and 语法分割（nd syntax splitting (?).

在由 SCC 递归性质引起的增量计算方法中，一 计算子框架中的扩展，并最终组合 从而计算扩展部分（如在分裂方法中）。 然而，与分裂相反，这仅限于组成的子框架In the incremental computation approach induced by the SCC-recursive property, one computes the extensions in subframeworks, and ultimately combines the thereby computed extension parts (as in the splitting approach). In contrast to splittings however, this is restricted to subframeworks that make up强连通分量strongly connected componentsw.r.t. SETAF 的原始图或 ABAF 的依赖图（w.r.t. the primal graph of the SETAF or the ABAF’s dependency graph (?; ?）。事实上，给定 SETAF 的原始图（分别是 ABAF 的依赖图），我们的方法对应于参数（分别是句子）之间的分割，使得所涉及的攻击（正边）具有相同的方向。 然而，在这方面，拆分更为普遍，因为子框架不必是 SCC。 最后，与基于句法操作的分割方法相比，SCC 递归依赖于广义语义来处理框架先前部分的决策。 这允许在现有 ABA 和 SETAF 求解器之上实施分割。). Indeed, given the primal graph of a SETAF (resp. an ABAF’s dependency graph), our approach corresponds to splitting between arguments (resp. sentences) such that the involved attacks (positive edges) have the same direction. However, splitting is more general in this regard, as the subframeworks do not have to be SCCs. Finally, SCC-recursiveness relies on a generalised semantics to deal with the decisions of prior parts of the framework, in contrast to the syntactic manipulation-based approach of splitting. This allows splitting to be implemented on top of existing ABA and SETAF solvers.

事实证明，ABA 在多种语义下捕获了具有否定失败的正常逻辑程序（It has been shown that ABA captures normal logic programs with negation-as-failure under several semantics (?）。特别是，逻辑编程中部分稳定的、有根据的和规则的模型对应于 ABA 中完整的、有根据的和首选的扩展。翻译的工作原理是将 LP 的每个否定（或肯定）文字转换为一个假设（或相反），反之亦然。通过这种简单的转换，我们的分裂算法可以在逻辑编程的背景下进行调整，以获得超出稳定语义的分治方法，从而概括原始结果（). In particular, partial stable, well-founded and regular models in logic programming correspond to complete, grounded and preferred extensions in ABA. The translation works by turning every negative (resp. positive) literals of an LP into an assumption (resp. contrary), and vice versa. By means of this simple transformation, our splitting algorithm can be adapted in the context of logic programming to obtain a divide-and-conquer approach beyond stable semantics, thus generalising the original result (?）。作为副产品，我们能够根据部分稳定、有充分依据和常规的模型在语义下分割正常的逻辑程序。). As a by-product, we are then able to split normal logic programs under semantics based on partially stable, well-founded and regular models.

ADF（ADFs (?）是一种表达性论证形式主义，其中每个论证都与作为接受条件的变量的论证的命题公式相关联。 众所周知，SETAF 可以解释为一种特殊的 ADF，其接受条件采用否定文字的析取子句的合取形式（) are an expressive argumentation formalism, where each argument is associated with a propositional formula over arguments as variables as an acceptance condition. It is well-known that SETAFs can be interpreted as a special kind of ADFs with acceptance conditions in the form of a conjunction of disjunctive clauses of negated literals (?）。也就是说，原则上我们可以将 ADF 分割应用于 SETAF。 然而，尚不清楚遵循 ADF 方法，修改后的第二个框架是否再次具有所需的（类似 SETAF 的）形式，以及是否可以在 SETAF 的更简单情况下避免某些开销。经过更仔细的检查和较小的句法操作，在类似 SETAF 的框架的特殊情况下，ADF 方法类似于引入一个人工的自我攻击论点，其行为类似于定义). That is, in principle we can apply ADF splitting to SETAFs. However, it is not clear that following the ADF approach the modified second framework again is of the desired (SETAF-like) form and whether one can avoid certain overheads in the simpler case of SETAFs. Upon closer inspection and with minor syntactic manipulation the ADF approach in the special case of SETAF-like frameworks is similar to introducing an artificial self-attacking argument that behaves similarly to Definition14。然而，在我们的例子中，SETAF 不需要这样的技巧。. However, such a trick is not needed for SETAFs in our case.

? (?）引入了概念) introduced the concept of语法分裂syntax splitting表征包含独立信息的信念集。在此设置中，语法分割包括将知识库划分为独立的组件，其中每个独立的信息可以仅使用这些划分的一部分来表示。在本文中，我们考虑了更普遍的分裂概念，其中知识库的不同部分可能不是彼此独立的。为此，我们提供了适当的修改来考虑这种相互依赖性。to characterize belief sets that contain independent pieces of information. In this setting, a syntax splitting consists of a partition of the knowledge base into independent components, where each independent piece of information can be represented using only one part of these partition. In this paper, we have considered a notion of splitting which is more general, where the different parts of the knowledge base may not be independent from each other. For this, we provided suitable modifications to account for such interdependencies.

9 结论和未来的工作Conclusion and Future Work

在本文中，我们提出了一种基于修改的方法来分割基于假设的论证框架。首先，我们引入了 SETAF 的拆分模式，以便在实例化后可以在 ABAF 上进行拆分。利用 SETAF 和 ABAF 之间的紧密联系，我们提出了一种通过相应的参数图间接执行 ABA 推理时的分裂方法。 此外，为了克服实例化的要求及其相关成本，我们引入了直接在 ABA 知识库上工作的拆分模式。 对于这两种方法，我们已经证明，通过简单的句法修改，可以从其子框架中增量地获得给定 ABAF 的扩展。相反，我们可以将整个框架的任意扩展投射到它的子框架上。 由于这与底层 ABAF 的特定结构相关，因此我们考虑了一种更通用的分裂变体，称为参数化分裂，其灵感来自于In this paper, we have presented a modification-based approach to splitting assumption-based argumentation frameworks. First, we have introduced a splitting schema for SETAFs, to make splitting available on ABAFs after instantiation. Leveraging on the close connection between SETAFs and ABAFs, we have thus proposed a way to split when reasoning in ABA is performed indirectly via the corresponding argument graph. Moreover, to overcome the requirement of an instantiation and its associated costs, we have introduced a splitting schema that works directly on ABA knowledge bases. For both approaches, we have shown that extensions of a given ABAF can be obtained incrementally from its sub-frameworks, by means of simple syntactic modifications. Conversely, we can project an arbitrary extension of the whole framework to its sub-frameworks. Since this is bound to the specific structure of the underlying ABAF, we have considered a more general variant of splitting called parametrised splitting inspired by? (?）。此外，很容易看出所涉及的每个步骤都可以有效地执行并在常见的 ABA（或 SETAF）求解器之上实现。 事实上，本文中介绍的拆分技术只需要对子框架进行句法修改，这不会导致大小呈指数级增加（在某些情况下，甚至可能会减小大小）。特别是，通过减少和修改，我们相对于原始子框架最多引入一个附加规则和一个附加假设。在参数化分裂的情况下，附加规则和假设的数量受下式限制：). Moreover, it is easy to see that each of the steps involved can be carried out efficiently and implemented on top of common ABA (or SETAF) solvers. Indeed, the splitting techniques introduced in the paper require only syntactic modifications to the sub-frameworks, which do not lead to an exponential increase in size (and may, in some cases, even reduce it). In particular, through the reduct and modification, we introduce at most one additional rule and one additional assumption with respect to the original sub-framework. In the case of parametrised splitting, the number of additional rules and assumptions is bounded by2​k2k对于一个for akk-分裂。 因此，下一步显然是实施我们的算法并本着以下精神进行实验评估-splitting. Therefore, an obvious next step is to implement our algorithm and perform an experimental evaluation in the spirit of? (?),其中，与不进行拆分的执行相比，采用拆分的执行平均加速 60%。特别是，我们认为参数化分裂在最近提出的论证性因果发现的背景下可能会有所帮助（where executions with splitting result in an average acceleration of 60% in comparison to executions without splitting. In particular, we believe that parametrised splitting could be helpful in the context of the recently proposed Argumentative Causal Discovery (?）。 事实上，该框架在可扩展性方面面临着重大挑战，因为它在较大实例上表现出次优性能。). In fact, this framework faces a major challenge in terms of its scalability, as it exhibits suboptimal performance on larger instances.
